name: Ulathek the Traitor
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You wish to enter my good graces?  Then kill for me.

My servant, Ulathek, is pathetic how he grovels before me, all the while plotting with Lord Hel'nurath on Xoroth.  Hel'nurath plans to usurp my power here, and Ulathek is his spy...

Prove that you serve me and not my rivals.  Confront Ulathek in his quarters, in the Shadow Hold to the west.  Tell him that I know his secret and watch as fear grips him.  Then, bring me the traitor's heart!
narrative.objectives: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, how splendid!  After rotting a week, this heart will prove a succulent treat!  Perhaps I will send for Ulathek's head and place it before me as I eat...

You have done me a service, warlock, and so my patience for you has grown.  Marginally.
narrative.requestItemsText: I can already taste the heart of Ulathek on my lips. So sweet is the flesh of a traitor...
